system.description: You inherited more of your clan's stolen Tzimisce blood than most of your clanmates, becoming something of a throwback to Clan Tremere's "parent" clan. You may choose Vicissitude rather than Dominate as a clan Discipline. Improving your Vicissitude rating past its basic levels is difficult, however: unless you can find another Tremere both willing and able to teach you the Discipline's higher mysteries, you must seek further instruction from the Tzimisce — almost always through coercion, since they have little reason to help you willingly.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
